title: Canyon Rise Cycle
description: Four images of the same red-rock canyon with a column of water rising from its floor, photographed under different atmospheric conditions.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the canyon, the vertical rising water column, and a helicopter scale anchor. 02-04 preserve geometry and column profile while changing time of day, weather, and atmospheric haze.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01 first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-04. Queue may run 02-04 concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
